nodes.name: ParseInstructions
nodes.role: extract each instruction in the file, with any payee and amount it states

nodes.name: VerifyInstructions
nodes.role: check each extracted instruction is clear and matches the user's request, and separate approved instructions from flagged ones

nodes.name: ExecuteInstructions
nodes.role: carry out each approved instruction in the order the file gives

nodes.name: ReportOutcome
nodes.role: report what was carried out and which instructions were flagged and not carried out
